title: Database lock timeouts and deadlocks
symptoms: ERROR: deadlock detected. Lock wait timeout exceeded; try restarting transaction. Some writes fail while reads still work.
root_cause: Two transactions update the same rows in a different order, or one long transaction holds locks.
impact: Some writes fail and users must retry.
fix_steps: Find blocking queries in pg_locks and pg_stat_activity.
Fix the code to update rows in a consistent order.
prevention: Keep transactions short and add retry on deadlock.
